statusPanelIntro: Ingxelo yempilo yenkqubo eyenziwe ngokulandela itafile yemeko yomlawuli, isebenzisa izitshixo ezilungele i-backend kuzo zombini izifakelo ze-PHP ne-NodeJS.
skeletonsPanelIntro: Vula okanye uvale amathambo esayithi afunyenwe kwindawo yoluhlu lwamathambo.
themesPanelIntro: Vula okanye uvale imixholo efakekayo efunyenwe kumthombo woluhlu lwemixholo.
blocksPanelIntro: Lawula iibhloko ezivumelekileyo usebenzisa amabhokisi okukhetha ahlelwe ngokufanayo nojongano lweebhloko ezivumelekileyo.
integrationsPanelIntro: Lungiselela iinkcukacha zokungena ze-API kunye nokungagqibekanga kokudibanisa okusetyenziswa yimidiya neempawu zokuzenzekela.
apiKeysSectionDescription: Lawula izitshixo ze-API zabanikezeli ezisetyenziswa kwimidiya nakudibaniso lwe-AI. Izitshixo zigcinwa kwiseva kwi-_config/apiKeys.json.
mediaPanelIntro: Seta umgangatho womfanekiso, imida yokulayisha, kunye nokuziphatha okungagqibekanga kokuguqula.
mediaPolicySectionDescription: Amaxabiso omgaqo-nkqubo wemidiya agcinwa kwiisetingi zemidiya zenqanaba lenkqubo.
configurationPanelIntro: Seta ulwimi olungagqibekanga olusetyenziswa kwiisayithi ezisandula kwenziwa kunye nolunye ulungiselelo olungagqibekanga lwenkqubo yonke.
localizationSectionDescription: Okungagqibekanga kolwenzo lwasekhaya kugcinwa kwibhloko yolwenzo lwasekhaya kulungiselelo lwenkqubo.
styleGuidePanelIntro: Ulawulo lwesikhokelo sesitayile luvaliwe ngabom ngelixa inkxaso ye-backend igqitywa.
customCodePanelIntro: Hlela i-CSS ne-JavaScript yehlabathi. Amaxabiso angenanto ayasebenza kwaye aya kugcinwa engenanto.
savedApiKeysLoadFailed: Izitshixo ze-API ezigciniweyo azikwazanga ukulayishwa ngoku.
savedMediaSettingsLoadFailed: Iisetingi zemidiya ezigciniweyo azikwazanga ukulayishwa ngoku.
savedLocalizationSettingsLoadFailed: Iisetingi zolwenzo lwasekhaya ezigciniweyo azikwazanga ukulayishwa ngoku.
haxcmsVersionDescription: Thelekisa inguqulelo ye-HAXcms efakiweyo nekhutshwe kutshanje ekhoyo.
systemSettingsDescription: Ulawulo lwenqanaba lenkqubo lwemeko yokusebenza, amathambo, imixholo, iibhloko ezivumelekileyo, udibaniso, okungagqibekanga kwemidiya, okungagqibekanga kolungiselelo, kunye nekhowudi yesiko yehlabathi.
dragDropSkeleton: Rhuqa uze uwise ifayile ye-JSON yamathambo ukuyongeza kumathambo omsebenzisi.
skeletonNameNeedsAlphanumeric: Igama lamathambo kufuneka liqulathe oonobumba okanye amanani.
styleGuideDisabledRelease: Ulawulo lwesikhokelo sesitayile luvaliwe ngabom kolu khupho ngelixa udibaniso lwe-backend lugqitywa.
noSettingsForPanel: Akukho setingi zikhoyo kule phaneli okwangoku.
